# SiliconPath

SiliconPath is the aggregator and academy for VLSI, semiconductor, and hardware engineering careers. No login required.

## Core Features
- Aggregation of JRF, SRF, RA, PhD, fellowship, government and industry opportunities for semiconductor and VLSI engineers.
- Opportunities from Indian institutions (IITs, IISc, NITs, DRDO, ISRO, CSIR) and international programs.
- Private sector roles (VLSI Design, Physical Design, Verification, DFT, Embedded Systems).
- Free structured VLSI Academy: 7 tracks (Digital Logic, Verilog, SystemVerilog, UVM, RTL Design, Physical Design, Interview Prep) with day-wise lessons, videos, quizzes and assessments.
- No login required. Bookmark opportunities and track academy progress locally in your browser.

## Main Sections
- [Opportunities](https://siliconpath.vercel.app/): Browse all active opportunities.
- [Categories](https://siliconpath.vercel.app/categories): Browse by category.
- [Companies](https://siliconpath.vercel.app/companies): Directory of organizations hiring in VLSI and semiconductors.
- [Search](https://siliconpath.vercel.app/search): Full-text search across opportunities.
- [VLSI Academy](https://siliconpath.vercel.app/academy): Structured learning tracks.

## Target Audience
Electronics Engineers, VLSI Researchers, Embedded Systems Professionals, and Students seeking research roles or VLSI careers.
